rest.documentation: The clinic directory, patients, consents, appointments and their consultations, the clinic's questionnaires and the patients' answers to them, and the documents written in a consultation. A signed-in session is a bearer token or the web app's cookie. The public directory (Organization?listed=true, a listed clinic's PractitionerRole search, Schedule and Slot) needs no session and is not audited. Every other interaction needs a session, shows a caller only what the access rules allow (anything else is 404) and is audited. Search values that are dates are instants with an offset, prefixed ge or lt. Any search parameter not listed here gives 400. Also GET /fhir/R4/metadata.

resource.documentation: Read: staff of the clinic. Update: the clinic's admin, with If-Match and the version read (a stale or missing version gives 412); it sets the name and, when given, the organization-listed, organization-timezone, organization-default-language and organization-patient-transcript-copy extensions (a left-out extension keeps its value; the default language is one of bs, hr, sr-Latn, sr-Cyrl, en). Search: anyone, listed=true only.

searchParam.name: listed
searchParam.documentation: Required, true only: the clinics listed in the public directory.

resource.documentation: Read: staff of the clinic. Search: staff of the clinic get its roles; anyone else, signed in or not, the active roles of a listed clinic with their specialty, and their practitioners with the name only (none for a clinic that is not listed).
The patient themselves, and a practitioner with the patient's active consent for the clinic and an appointment with them. Anyone else, the clinic's admin included, gets 404.

The patient, and staff of the consent's clinic. Two kinds: the care consent, and the transcription consent (SAL-12), told apart by its second category (v3-ActCode ICOL) and its provision actions (consentaction collect, use).
Anyone: the schedules of active practitioner roles of listed clinics.
Anyone: the free slots of a schedule of the public directory that start after now, by start.

As the access rules allow: the patient their own; the practitioner theirs and the clinic's admin the clinic's while the patient's consent is active; after a revocation, past appointments only, with the patient's name, the times and the status. The patient participant carries the name only where the caller may see it. A practitioner must search by themselves.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: One patient; a patient always gets their own.

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: Appointment start: at most one ge and one lt.

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: One of booked, cancelled, fulfilled, noshow.

resource.documentation: The video consultation of an appointment, class VR: in-progress from the practitioner's first join, finished when it ends. No create or update: the consultation's lifecycle drives it. Seen by whoever sees its appointment: the patient their own; the practitioner theirs and the clinic's admin the clinic's while the patient's consent is active; after a revocation, those of appointments that started before it. A practitioner's search gives their own encounters only, and naming another practitioner gives 403.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: One patient; a patient always gets their own.

searchParam.name: practitioner
searchParam.documentation: One practitioner, the one behind the participant's practitioner role.

resource.documentation: A document drafted during a consultation from one of the clinic's templates: preliminary while it is drafted and edited, final once the encounter's practitioner signed it (attester, mode legal). Each field of the template is a section, its value the narrative; a field with no value has an emptyReason. Read by the encounter's practitioner while the patient's consent is active, and a final one by its patient whatever the consent (their own record; a preliminary one is not found for them); anyone else gets 403 or 404. No create or update: drafts are written and signed through the JSON API.

The PDF of a signed Composition (context.related), linked to its Encounter; the attachment's url is the JSON API's download of the PDF. Read and search: the encounter's practitioner while the patient's consent is active, and its patient whatever the consent (their own record); a draft has none.

searchParam.name: encounter
searchParam.documentation: One encounter, required: its signed documents, in the order they were signed.

resource.documentation: Who signed a Composition and when: its targets are the Composition's signed version and its DocumentReference. Read under the Composition's rule.

A version of one of the clinic's questionnaires: draft, active (published, never changed again) or retired. Read and search: staff of the clinic, and a patient the versions their own questionnaire responses answer; anyone else gets 404 on a read; a search gives staff of another clinic nothing, and a patient without a profile 403. No create or update: questionnaires are built through the JSON API. Help text is a child display item with the questionnaire-itemControl extension, code help.

searchParam.name: url
searchParam.documentation: One canonical url of this server, https://salus.invalid/fhir/Questionnaire/<id>, without a version: every version of one questionnaire. Any other url gives 400.

resource.documentation: A questionnaire the appointment's practitioner (or the practitioner role's default, with the booking) asked the patient to fill in before an appointment, and the patient's answers, nested under the questionnaire's sections. As the access rules allow: the patient their own; the appointment's practitioner the answers once submitted and the status before, the clinic's admin the status only, while the patient's consent is active; after a revocation, the submitted responses of appointments that started before it only. Anyone else gets 404 on a read and nothing from a search. Every response carries the questionnaireresponse-appointment extension. No create or update: requests and answers go through the JSON API.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: One patient; a patient always gets their own.
